frame: local ENU tangent plane at the origin (WGS84); Godot +X east, +Y up, -Z north; row 0 = north edge, column 0 = west edge

height.reference: ENU up relative to the origin; geoid and Earth curvature included

ground_model.method: DEM filled in under building footprints from the surrounding samples, lowered by half the canopy height under trees, never above the DEM (tools/buildings.py)

color.encoding: PNG RGB8, sRGB (Sentinel-2 L2A true colour (TCI))

water.encoding: PNG L8, share of the cell covered by water (255 = all water), rows north to south

landcover.encoding: PNG L8, ESA WorldCover 2021 class value (10 tree cover, 20 shrubland, 30 grassland, 40 cropland, 50 built-up, 60 bare, 70 snow and ice, 80 water, 90 wetland, 95 mangroves, 100 moss and lichen; 0 no data), nearest neighbour

source.citation: Zanaga, D. et al. (2022) ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, doi:10.5281/zenodo.7254221

canopy.encoding: PNG L8, canopy top height above ground in quarter metres (value / 4 = metres, 0..63.75), nearest neighbour; no data = 0

source.product: ETH Global Canopy Height 10 m 2020 (Lang et al. 2023)

buildings.encoding: godot-geo buildings v1 (see tools/buildings.py): zlib tiles of footprints with base, heights, roof shape, colours and roof triangles; positions in the package frame

source.product: Overture Maps buildings (OpenStreetMap; Microsoft ML footprints where OSM has none)

buildings.license: ODbL-1.0 (derived from OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps)

footprints.encoding: PNG L8, 255 where a building footprint touches the height sample's cell, else 0
footprints.license: ODbL-1.0 (derived from OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps)

roads.encoding: godot-geo roads v1 (see tools/roads.py): zlib tiles of polylines with class, flags, width and bridge deck heights; package frame
